WHAT: Jarvis is the full persistent AI assistant that memory-ts was extracted from. Still actively developed — Feb 25 2026 commit rewrote curation.
WHERE: github.com/RLabs-Inc/jarvis (checked March 2026)
HOW IT DIFFERS FROM MEMORY-TS:
- Standalone CLI + Telegram bot, not a Claude Code plugin
- Runs on Mac Mini as persistent agent with cron (6 AM daily reflection)
- Tiered memory: eternal/long_term/recent with different cache lifetimes
- Tier 1 (identity) cached for 1 hour, Tier 3 (recent context) refreshed every 5 min

KEY BREAKTHROUGH (Feb 25 commit): 'Curate my own memories with Opus + chunked processing — preserve both facts AND texture. Curation prompts rewritten from my perspective, not as a sub-agent.'

WHY RELEVANT: The 'facts AND texture' approach is exactly what was missing from memory-ts curation — surface-level one-liners instead of capturing the actual substance. The tiered caching (not flat retrieval every message) is also smarter.

WHY NOT USE JARVIS DIRECTLY: Requires separate API token usage (against Anthropic rules for Claude Code OAuth), adds Telegram/external interface Ned doesn't want. Claude Code is the interface.

ACTION: Steal the 'facts AND texture' curation prompt philosophy and tiered cache concept for the memory-ts fork. Don't copy the architecture.
